preconditions.description: The dimensions of the map and the number of allowed different types of squares are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(map) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in map)
preconditions.description: The map has exactly n rows and each row has exactly m columns.
There is exactly one 'S' and one 'T' in the map.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a sequence of plot types representing the path from 'S' to 'T', excluding 'S' and 'T'.

postconditions.expression: all(plot_type in set(map) - {'S', 'T'} for plot_type in return_value)
postconditions.description: All plot types in the output are valid and exist in the map, excluding 'S' and 'T'.
The number of different plot types visited does not exceed k.
The path starts at 'S' and ends at 'T'.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(path[i][0] - path[i+1][0]) + abs(path[i][1] - path[i+1][1]) == 1 for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each step in the path moves to an adjacent square.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= path[i][0] < n and 0 <= path[i][1] < m for i in range(len(path)))
postconditions.description: All steps in the path are within the map boundaries.
